user.title: ha-user-directory
user.description: Adds a User-Directory page to the sidebar: a phone book of the users on this server, where each user can also edit their own contact info.

email_test.title: Send a test email
email_test.description: Sends an email using the saved email verification settings.{detail}

data.publish_policy: Who is listed in the directory

data_description.publish_policy: Listed users show their name, picture, email and phone to every user. Social links only show if each user turns them on.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.description: Supported SSO integration: {status}. API token saved: {token_saved}.

data_description.oidc_enabled: Only available when a supported SSO integration is set up and working. Turning this off forgets the token and the SSO values.
data_description.authentik_token: Token for an Authentik service account that can only view users. Leave blank to keep the saved token.
data_description.oidc_enforce: When on, fields filled from SSO can't be changed in Home Assistant, only in Authentik. When off, SSO only fills fields the user left empty.

email.title: Email verification
email.description: Lets users verify their email by entering a code sent to it. A verified email is needed for Gravatar. Leave the server blank to turn this off. Password saved: {password_saved}.

data_description.smtp_port: Leave blank for the usual port: 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SSL/TLS, 25 for none.
data_description.smtp_username: Leave blank if the server doesn't need a login.
data_description.smtp_password: Leave blank to keep the saved password.

error.provider_not_active: No supported SSO integration is set up. Install and configure OpenID Connect/SSO (hass-oidc-auth) first.
error.invalid_token: Authentik rejected the API token, or it can't view users.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the SSO identity provider.
error.unsupported_idp: The SSO identity provider isn't Authentik. Only Authentik is supported.
error.smtp_cannot_connect: Can't connect to the SMTP server. Check the server, port and encryption.
error.smtp_auth_failed: The SMTP server rejected the username or password.
error.smtp_send_failed: The SMTP server wouldn't send the email. Check the from address and that the server allows it.

abort.test_sent: Test email sent to {email}. If it doesn't arrive, check the spam folder and the server's logs.
